title: GDSC VinUni joins the network
text: The chapter is founded as Google Developer Student Club VinUniversity and joins GDSC Vietnam.

title: Generation 1
text: The first members join across Tech (Web, AI), HR, Media and External Relations, with Lưu Bảo Yến as lead.

title: Workshop Series begins
text: Four sessions prepare members for the Solution Challenge and Hackathon Vietnam, built around the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

title: Student Champions of Change
text: VinUniversity recognises the club with its Student Champions of Change award.

title: GDSC becomes GDG on Campus
text: Along with chapters worldwide, the club takes its new name: Google Developer Group on Campus VinUniversity. Generation 2 joins.

title: Sonder 2025
text: A cross-border online event with GDG on Campus chapters from Vietnam and the Philippines.

title: Hackathon Vietnam Demo Day at VinUni
text: The northern Demo Day of GDGoC Hackathon Vietnam 2025 takes place on our campus. Theme: Responsible AI.

title: Generation 3
text: New teams form: AI & Data and Software Engineering, alongside Media, Operations & HR and External Relations.

title: Build Your Next
text: Generation 4 recruitment opens with four stations: Tech, Operations & HR, Marketing & Communications, and Community Members.
